nextAction: Claimed for Lane B authoring. Chapters 1-10 of 107 are in progress. Cotton's translation in both editions, 4,897 paragraphs per edition, aligned. Two difficulties at once: the modern edition modernises transliterations (Wicliffe/Wycliffe, Zisca/Zizka, Trivulcio/Trivulzio, Fabricio/Fabrizio, Juliano/Giuliano, Fregosa/Fregoso, Sylla/Sulla, AEneid/Aeneid), and an essayist who cites for eleven hundred pages has a great many namesakes (two Plinys, two Diodoruses, two kings called Darius, two dukes called Alva, two men called Trivulzio, three called du Bellay, a Zeno who is a citizen of Messina and not the Stoic, a Perseus who is a king of Macedon and not the Gorgon-slayer). Names belonging to a person a later chapter introduces are left unbound rather than defaulted, so the position tables have no defaults.
